collection.title: Saab 9-3 Estate 2008 to 2012 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following blades for the Saab 9-3 Estate 2008 to 2012 will fit, this model requires a 23" wiper blade on both the drivers side and the passengers side. This model uses the Pinch Tab arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also offer a rear screen wiper for this Saab which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.
